feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 May 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 15 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Weak ridge of high pressure is gradually displaced from the west as a weather front arrives tomorrow.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, but variable 2 to 4 in the southwest of the area at first, becoming west or northwest 2 to 4 in all waters overnight before backing south or southeast later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers in the west at first, otherwise fair. Occasional rain or drizzle approaching from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 2 to 4, quickly veering west 4 or 5 and occasionally force 6 in places. Backing and increasing southwest 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle soon clearing to showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in precipitation.
